items.title: Jim Galloway interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 15, 1998
items.q: Ray Anderson moved me, one of the younger trombone players, and knows the roots of the music.

ctx.x: Who are the great ones today that have it?

Well that’s a hard one. Because you have to put different sort of parameters on the music. I mean it’s very difficult to put people in compartments I find, but the critics in particular were very fond of creating these categories that people would fit into. But jazz has become so multi-faceted now that it’s very difficult I think to define it, it’s impossible to define it.
